You can tell by the sound of the engines—|Thane Kyrell|''[[Lost Stars]]''}} The '''''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle''', also known as the '''''Lambda''-class shuttle''', '''Imperial Lambda''', '''Imperial Transport''' or the '''Imperial Shuttle''', was a multi-purpose [[transport]] with a trihedral foil design used by the [[Galactic Empire]], and was considered an elegant departure from the standards of brutish Imperial engineering. The [[shuttle]]s were often used by dignitaries and high-[[Military rank|ranking]] [[Imperial officer|officer]]s, but were more commonly found ferrying [[stormtrooper]]s or cargo. Some ''Lambda''-class shuttles were retained in service by both [[New Republic]] and remaining [[Imperial Remnants|Imperial remnants]] during the [[New Republic Era]], being used primarily to transport [[prisoner]]s. ==Description== {{Quote|So, the problem with these ''Lambda''-class shuttles, they fly fine with one, but it's much easier with a copilot… especially through hyperspace.|[[Luke Skywalker]], to [[Shara Bey]]|}} [[File:LambdaShuttleDocked-Fathead.png|thumb|left|200px|A ''Lambda''-class shuttle in landing configuration, with boarding ramp lowered.]] A [[hyperdrive]]-equipped multi-purpose [[transport]], the ''Lambda''-class T-4a [[shuttle]] was developed by [[Sienar Fleet Systems]] for use in the [[Imperial Navy]]. Measuring 20 [[meter]]s in length, the ''Lambda''-class could attain a max speed of 850 [[Kilometer per hour|kph]], and was one of the more common [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Starship|ships]] found throughout [[the galaxy]]—along with its nearly-identical counterpart, the [[Sentinel-class landing craft|''Sentinel''-class landing craft]]. It had three wings: one tall, dorsal [[stabilizer]] that remained stationary, and two lower articulated flanking wings. While in flight, the wings folded outwards for greater stabilization, while during landing procedures the wings folded inward, reducing the vessel's silhouette. This triangular shape was considered elegant and a departure from the Empire's usually crude designs. Although ''Lambda''-class craft could be flown by a single [[pilot]], the presence of a copilot/[[navigator]] made it much easier, especially when traveling through [[hyperspace]]. Additionally, in order to prove that the shuttle crew was working for the Empire, ''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttles utilized special transponders to transmit secret codes to [[Star Destroyer]]s. Through a switch in the cockpit, the cockpit could detach as an emergency [[escape pod]].
[[File:ScopiumsPod-2020StarWars27.png|thumb|300px|The cockpit of a Lambda shuttle detaches as a last minute escape pod.]]
Despite the elegance of the ''Lambda''-class's outer design, the inside of many shuttles often reeked of stale sweat owing to the numerous perspiring [[stormtrooper]]s they hauled across the [[galaxy]]. Moreover, bored [[trooper]]s were known to scratch their [[operating number]]s on every available surface.''[[Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!]]'' A well-armed vessel, the ''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle was equipped with two forward-facing double [[laser cannon]]s, two forward-facing wing-mounted double [[cannon]]s, and a retractable rear-mounted double [[laser]] cannon. ==History== ===Imperial Era=== {{Quote|Let's see what this piece of junk can do.|Han Solo|}} The Imperial ''Lambda''-class shuttle was the conceptual and engineering offspring of the [[Nu-class attack/transport shuttle|''Nu''-class transport]], a versatile craft that saw use during the [[Clone Wars]].{{SWE|technology|republicattackshuttle|Republic attack shuttle}} Even the top members of the Empire's hierarchy, including [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]] himself and his [[Sith apprentice]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], traveled in their own private ''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttles; with the [[Emperor's personal shuttle|Emperor's shuttle]] distinguished by a gray stripe on its nose.{{SWE|technology|imperialshuttle|Imperial shuttle}} [[Governor]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] and his [[death trooper]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin's guard|guard]] arrived at [[Landing Pad 13]] of the [[Imperial Center of Military Research|Imperial security complex]] on the planet [[Scarif]] aboard a Lambda.[[Darth Vader Annual 2|''Darth Vader Annual'' 2]] [[File:LambdaClassShuttle-SWM.png|thumb|left|250px|A ''Lambda''-class shuttle takes off from Endor]] To escape the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station]] and [[Mission to reveal the Death Star II|reveal its existence]], undercover [[Crimson Dawn]] [[Sleeper Agent|agents]] [[Jon Melton]] and [[Bevelyn]] killed [[Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Major]] [[Sharin]] and stole her ''Lambda''-class shuttle[[Star Wars (2020) 26|''Star Wars'' (2020) 26]] ''[[Scopium]]''. Although they were soon chased by [[TIE/IN interceptor]]s, they escaped to a location the Empire would not expect, the Imperial capital of [[Coruscant]], and abandoned the ship.[[Star Wars (2020) 27|''Star Wars'' (2020) 27]] During the [[Battle of Jakku]], ''Lambda''-class shuttles acted as evacuation shuttles from downed Imperial vessels, as well as [[troop transport]]s to deliver [[Imperial Army|Imperial ground forces]] to firefights across the surface.''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]'' During the battle, [[New Republic]] [[New Republic pilot|pilot]] [[Norra Wexley]] and former Imperial [[Grand Admiral]] [[Rae Sloane]] used a ''Lambda''-class shuttle while tracking down [[Gallius Rax]].''[[Aftermath: Empire's End]]'' ===New Republic Era=== [[File:SlaveIFiresOnShuttle2743-TMch16.png|thumb|250px|right|''Slave I'' firing on Shuttle 2743]] During the [[New Republic Era]], the shuttle would see use by the New Republic and [[Gideon's Imperial remnant]], which used [[Shuttle 2743]]. [[Doctor]] [[Penn Pershing]] was traveling on it when it was raided by [[Din Djarin]] and his allies to capture the doctor. They then used it to crash aboard [[Gideon's light cruiser]]. After [[Moff]] [[Gideon]] was captured{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 16: The Rescue}} for the [[New Republic Tribunal]],{{BOBF|Chapter 5: Return of the Mandalorian}} he was transported aboard a Lambda by the [[New Republic officer]]s, but he [[Extraction of Moff Gideon|escaped]]. [[Standard decade|Decades]] later, the Empire's successor state, the [[First Order]] borrowed design philosophies exuded from the ''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle into their newer [[Xi-class light shuttle|''Xi''-class light shuttle]][[Poe Dameron 19|''Poe Dameron'' 19]] and [[Upsilon-class command shuttle|''Upsilon''-class command shuttle]].''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: Incredible Cross-Sections]]'' ==Behind the scenes== The shuttles first appeared in the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]. In the [[1997]] [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|Special Edition rerelease]], a ''Lambda''-class shuttle was added to the [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']].{{Film|V}} The shuttle's classification comes from the Greek letter Lambda (uppercase '''Λ''', lowercase '''λ'''), whose lowercase form resembles the ship in flight mode. The ''Lambda''-class shuttle's name began a trend of naming shuttles after Greek letters, even if the particular letter's shape does not necessarily resemble the ship in question. This continued to [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']] with the inclusion of the [[Theta-class T-2c shuttle|''Theta''-class T-2c shuttle]], and later [[Star Wars Legends]] works. The trend was brought into [[Canon]] with the introduction of the [[Beta-class shuttle|''Beta'']], [[Gamma-class assault shuttle|''Gamma'']], [[Delta-class T-3c shuttle|''Delta'']], [[Zeta-class shuttle|''Zeta'']], [[Eta-class shuttle|''Eta'']], [[Mu-class shuttle|''Mu'']], [[Nu-class attack/transport shuttle|''Nu'']], [[Xi-class light shuttle|''Xi'']], [[Omicron-class attack shuttle|''Omicron'']], [[Rho-class transport shuttle|''Rho'']], and [[Upsilon-class command shuttle|''Upsilon'']]-class shuttles, some of which were inspired by Legends counterparts. ==Appearances==
